prs.title: Direct ECS deploys for staging (cutover phase C)
prs.author: Chad

stories.name: Safer AI Chat with Real-Time Task Updates
stories.rationale: Added guardrails to AI chat completions to prevent unsafe outputs and ensured the task list refreshes automatically after any write operations.

stories.name: Fix Cache Reliability for Queue Operations
stories.rationale: Resolved a Redis CROSSSLOT error by replacing the queue drain method with clean loops, improving cache stability in clustered environments.

stories.name: Streamlined Production Deployment Pipeline
stories.rationale: Completed a multi-phase deployment cutover (phases C, D, and E) that migrated staging to direct ECS deploys, removed legacy routing escape hatches, and introduced reviewer-gated production promotion for safer, more controlled releases.
